message.content: This is the **manga details/info screen** in a manga reader app. The UI displays the manga’s cover, title (*Raijin's Fury*), source (MangaDex), progress (75% through Chapter 36 of 48), key stats (chapters, size, language), a truncated description, and a prominent “Continue” button to resume reading. Top navigation includes options like “Set to Private,” share/download icons, and a back arrow.
